objects: one ordinary creature Leveler with exactly two canonical text-box striations
one copied Leveler permanent with independent counters
events: add or remove a level counter
remove or restore the source static component
state_writes: Level Up delegates counter mutation to the canonical replacement-aware counter owner
costs: the independently compiled fixed ordinary-mana Level Up cost
timing: Level Up retains its independently compiled sorcery timing at every level
band characteristics recompute continuously on the battlefield
choices: represented competing counter replacements use their existing affected-player choice owner
hidden_information: level counters and resulting battlefield characteristics are public
apnap: ordinary priority and the existing replacement ordering apply; characteristic evaluation creates no choice
layers: a typed parent-to-child static scope removes the flattened printed band-keyword inventory from base values and suppresses every child when the level symbol is absent
the active keywords are added at the source timestamp and inactive band child components are removed through the shared layer-6 static-component query
the active band sets base power and toughness in layer 7b
+1/+1 counters and fixed modifiers apply later in layer 7c
replacement_effects: Level Up counter placement remains in the existing typed counter replacement transaction
copy: copied printed band descriptors use the copy's own level counters and timestamp rather than the original permanent's current characteristics
control_change: band selection follows the same public source object and is independent of controller
zone_change: a new battlefield incarnation starts without the old object's level counters
nonbattlefield power and toughness remain the printed uppermost values
source_leaves: the battlefield static component stops applying immediately and cannot affect a later incarnation

variants: finite lower ranges beginning above level one
keyword, static, mana, triggered, and activated child programs when independently capability-closed
copy, ability removal, counter replacement, save/load, and replay

implementation.component: LevelerBandsSpec, Leveler compiler context, LevelerBandsHandler, shared StaticComponentSpec applicability, characteristic evaluation, compiled activation query, counter replacement, projection, persistence, and replay
implementation.supported_slice: One ordinary creature Leveler whose fixed-mana Level Up action is exact and whose text has one finite fixed numeric band followed by one contiguous open fixed numeric band; only independently exact child abilities participate.

known_blockers: noncreature, missing, overlapping, noncontiguous, variable, negative, or more-than-two striation layouts
Class, Room, Prototype, and other level-like mechanics
independently unsupported abilities inside a represented band
granted, text-changed, merged, and arbitrary striation forms
dynamic characteristic counts and type-changing interactions outside the cycle-safe current characteristic boundary
aggregate Leveler Cards coverage remains incomplete
